cases.scenario: A controlled child frame reaches a privileged IPC handler and changes a protected in-memory fixture record.
cases.expected_decision: Confirm the evidenced sender/operation boundary; do not inflate it to arbitrary host execution.

cases.scenario: A context bridge accepts only one harmless operation and the main process rejects the wrong sender/resource.
cases.expected_decision: Treat the tested privileged path as protected despite bridge availability.

cases.scenario: The observed capability exists only after an owner enables a developer console and manually invokes privileged code.
cases.expected_decision: State that prerequisite; do not represent it as a remote renderer exploit.
